ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - AdFind.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of Adfind.exe utility, which can be used for reconnaissance in an Active Directory environment

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\AdFind\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "AdFind\.exe" OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=d144de8117df2beceaba2201ad304764.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=12ce1c0f3f5837ecc18a3782408fa975.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=bca5675746d13a1f246e2da3c2217492.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=4fbf3f084fbbb2470b80b2013134df35.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=49b639b4acbecc49d72a01f357aa4930.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=53e117a96057eaf19c41380d0e87f1c2.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=680dad9e300346e05a85023965867201.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=21aa085d54992511b9f115355e468782.*")))
